map.数字评分法（Numerical Rating Scale），0-10分评估疼痛程: The Numerical Rating Scale scores pain 0-10, paired with the Wong-Baker Faces Scale. Click a number to pick the level.
map.📖 查看「疼痛数字评分 (NRS) 与表情对照器 使用指南」: View "Pain NRS & Faces Matcher User Guide"
map.本工具依据疼痛评估规范整理 NRS 评分参考，供护理记录使用，用药以医嘱为准。: This tool compiles NRS references per pain-assessment standards for nursing records; medication follows the order.
map.1-3分：轻度疼痛 → 不影响睡眠，可观察或非药物干预: 1-3: mild -> no sleep impact, observe or non-drug
map.7-10分：重度疼痛 → 严重影响睡眠和生活，需积极药物镇痛: 7-10: severe -> severe sleep/life impact, active analgesia
map.🙂 2分 - 微痛：有一点疼痛，但不明显: 🙂 2 - Slight: a little pain, not obvious
map.😐 4分 - 稍痛：疼痛明显，皱眉但仍可忍受: 😐 4 - Mild: clear pain, frowns but tolerable
map.😭 10分 - 极痛：想象中最剧烈的疼痛，哭诉不止: 😭 10 - Worst: the most intense pain imaginable, crying
map.术后每 4–6h 静息与活动双评，NRS≥4 报告处理。: Post-op: rest and activity scores every 4-6 h; NRS>=4 report for action.
map.癌痛按暴发痛与基础痛分别记录，指导滴定。: Cancer pain: record breakthrough vs baseline separately to guide titration.
map.语言障碍或小儿用面部表情辅助对应分值。: For speech barriers or children, use faces to map the score.
map.输入静息 3、活动 6，工具标活动痛≥4 需干预并建议复评，与疼痛评估一致。: Input rest 3, activity 6; tool flags activity >=4 needs intervention and recheck, matching assessment.
map.本工具能替代医师镇痛决策吗？: Can this tool replace the physician's analgesia decision?
map.不能，仅作评分记录，用药以医嘱为准。: No; it only records scores. Medication follows the order.
map.患者说不清数字怎么办？: What if the patient can't state a number?
map.用面部表情量表或 FLACC（小儿）对应，勿臆测。: Map via faces or FLACC (pediatric); do not guess.
map.评分忽高忽低？: Why does the score jump around?
map.结合活动、情绪、用药时点，固定评估条件复评。: Consider activity, mood and med timing; recheck under fixed conditions.
